newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki edges to record-high close, Nokia steady.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki edges to record-high close, Nokia steady.

text.p: * Bourse edges to record-high close on HEX index in thin trade Thursday with focus on whether recent Wall Street rally will hold, ignoring domestic surveys showing better prospects for key industries. Lively action in some small-cap stocks. Silja up on debt-for-equity swap. Nokia, UPM-Kymmene, Merita unchanged.
* HEX +0.32 pct to 2,380.36 * Volume FIM 380 million
